messages:
Ari (CSM): Kicking off NovaEdge onboarding. Goal: 30d pilot with API integration, SSO cutover, p95 latency target < 300ms, and 90%+ pass on intents verification. List owners & quick wins.
Maya (NovaEdge PM): Hi all Maya here. I'll own product acceptance. Key metrics: intent accuracy >= 0.9 and search NDCG uplift >= 0.1.
Omar (NovaEdge Infra): Omar Infra lead. OIDC metadata at https://sso.novaedge.com/. We need Redwood outbound IPs and a 1hr DNS cutover window. Available Sat 2024-05-04 02:00-03:00 UTC.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Ben here. Plan: week1 connector + SSO smoke, week2 bench + relevance tuning, week3 acceptance + enablement. Request labeled eval set (50-150 examples) by day 7. I'll provision a sandbox and share creds.
Ari (CSM): I'll send allowlist and schedule three workshops: tech deep-dive, prompts lab, and support handoff. Also setting up a 4-question weekly feedback form.
ProvisionBot: sandbox provisioned: novaedge-pilot-sbx v1 at 4412345680 (creds pending)
Ben (Solutions Eng): Deploy noted. Question: start with prefix/KV caching ON or OFF? Recommendation: OFF first 2 weeks to surface raw outputs. Will add per-route tags for spend tracking.
Maya (NovaEdge PM): Agree caching OFF initially. Please record enablement and upload to our internal wiki. Also want per-route cost visibility.
Omar (NovaEdge Infra): We'll open egress to specific IPs once provided. Confirming Sat window above.
Ari (CSM): Action items: Ari -> send allowlist + feedback link; Ben -> post curl examples + sandbox creds; Maya -> deliver labeled eval + acceptance doc; Omar -> confirm OIDC metadata + maintenance window. Renewal risk: if active pilot traffic < 30% of target by day 21, escalate to AM.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Curl example for sandbox:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $NOVA_SBX" -d '{"input":"Extract order total from invoice #789"}' https://sbx.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Maya (NovaEdge PM): We'll provide the labeled set (100 examples) by EOD Fri. Looking forward to kickoff.
Ari (CSM): Thanks everyone I'll send invites and the acceptance criteria doc link in this thread. Quick daily stand notes will be posted here for the first 10 days. :thumbsup:
